embeds.title: PSBL MLB NEWS
embeds.description: The league-wide baseball news feed: reports worth knowing that don't belong in a specialty channel. Stories are posted by automation as a headline, a source name and a direct link. Full articles are never copied; open the link to read the source.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: Team and league developments • Managerial and front-office changes • Role changes: closer jobs, rotation spots, lineup spots • Interviews • Meaningful analysis

fields.name: FILTERED OUT
fields.value: Scores, routine highlights, daily discussion threads and feed-section labels.

fields.name: LOOKING FOR SOMETHING ELSE?
fields.value: Injuries go to **🏥│injury-report**, signings and trades to **🔄│mlb-transactions**, prospects to **🌱│prospect-wire**, and major news to **🚨│breaking-news**.
